turnaround_reason: FOXF was hammered by a bike-channel inventory glut and soft powersports/truck-accessory demand through 2024-2025, plus Marucci integration drag. Q2 2026 marked a clear operational inflection: EPS $0.37 vs $0.185 est (~100% beat), powersports +22.5%, cost-out programs biting, and management raised full-year sales guidance.
bullish_points: Q2 2026 blowout: adj EPS $0.37 doubled the $0.185 consensus; adj EBITDA topped high end of guide by ~$5M
Full-year revenue guidance RAISED to $1.42B-$1.47B; adj EBITDA tightened to $176M-$196M with H2 margin expansion expected
Powersports segment +22.5%; bike volumes normalizing as supplier disruptions resolve; delayed Marucci bat launch shifts revenue into H2
Off the 52-week lows ($13.08) but still ~30% below the 52-week high ($30.56) — inflection not yet fully priced
Positive FCF ($48.9M) and healthy current ratio (3.1); analyst mean target ($21.83) roughly at spot with recent upgrades likely
bearish_points: Still GAAP-unprofitable on a TTM basis (profit margin -20.4%, weighed by prior impairments); revenue -4.5% YoY
Debt/equity ~102%, total debt $680M vs $61M cash — leverage limits margin for error if demand softens
Consumer-cyclical exposure (high-end bikes, trucks, powersports) is discretionary and rate/tariff sensitive
Recovery thesis leans on H2 cost-out execution and product-launch timing that can slip
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings (Nov 5) confirming H2 margin expansion and the guidance raise, plus continued powersports/bike volume normalization
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings 2026-11-05; H2 margin ramp through year-end
suggested_trade: Small-to-medium starter spot at $21-22; add on a hold of the 50-day post-earnings. Aggressive accounts can consider Jan 2027 $22-25 calls given the guidance-raise momentum.
key_risk: A discretionary-demand rollover (bike/powersports/truck) in H2 that stalls the guided margin expansion and re-exposes the leveraged balance sheet.
would_skip_if: Q3 print misses the raised guide or powersports growth decelerates sharply; or the stock extends above ~$26 (52w-high zone) before entry, killing the risk/reward.
